result.summary: Identified two primary issues involving content duplication and visual placeholder quality.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' restaurant is duplicated consecutively in the 'Fastest near you' carousel.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the list logic filters for unique restaurant IDs to prevent redundant display.

issues.description: Horizontal cards use identical, generic vector illustrations instead of specific food photography.
issues.suggestion: Implement dynamic loading of actual restaurant storefront images to enhance user recognition.
